{{Quote|There's a wandering Tredwall sales rep&mdash;a Rodian who calls himself "Faddo"&mdash;who picks up gullible marks on the Vohai Unirail. He got me pretty good, and for some reason the law won't (or can't) catch Faddo. Anybody else out there been suckered by this grubber? If so, meet me on Selonia in the next standard month; I'm planning a little party for this grifter.|[[Drev (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Drev]], on [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />}}
'''"Faddo"''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who worked as a wandering [[Tredwall]] sales representative, selling defective [[NR knockoff]]s on the [[Vohai Unirail]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />
